```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
source(here("lib", "single_cell", "helper_Seurat.R"))

# document specific packages: 
library(Seurat)
library(reticulate)

file_cache_dir <- file.path(cache_dir, "sc-processing-sctransform-stromal")
if (!dir.exists(file_cache_dir)) dir.create(file_cache_dir)
```

# Make Seurat object

```{python}
from pyhere import here
from pathlib import Path
import anndata
adata = anndata.read_h5ad(Path(here(), "data", "scRNAseq", "adata_stromal.h5ad"))
# reticulate mis-converts a categorical column whose codes are int32 (i.e.
# >32767 levels; cell_barcode has 43k). Cast those to str so obs reaches R intact.
for _c in adata.obs.columns:
    if str(adata.obs[_c].dtype) == "category" and len(adata.obs[_c].cat.categories) > 32767:
        adata.obs[_c] = adata.obs[_c].astype(str)
```

```{r}
counts <- Matrix::t(py$adata$layers$get("counts"))
rownames(counts) <- row.names(py$adata$var)
colnames(counts) <- row.names(py$adata$obs)

# Seurat 4's CreateSeuratObject ran make.names() on meta.data columns, turning
# obs names like patient-clin into patient.clin; Seurat 5 keeps them verbatim.
# The book refers to the dotted forms, so sanitize here.
obs <- py$adata$obs
names(obs) <- make.names(names(obs))
so <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts, 
  project = "adata_stromal", 
  assay = "RNA", 
  meta.data = obs
)
so
```

# Run SCTransform

```{r}
so <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "so_stromal.rds"), 
  function() {
    out <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(
      so,
      run_SCT = TRUE,
      resolutions = seq(0.1, 1, 0.1),
      dims = 1:30
    )
    out <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(out)
  }
)

so <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(so)
```


```{r}
metadata_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so)
```

# Clustering Analysis

```{r, fig.asp = 1}
#| fig-asp: 1

metadata_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-SCT_snn_res.1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "SCT_snn_res")) %>%
  plot_umap(color_str = "value") +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = value),
    data = ~ ..1 %>%
      group_by(name, value) %>%
      summarise(UMAP_1 = mean(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = mean(UMAP_2))
  ) +
  facet_wrap( ~ name) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
dge_one.v.all_sct.res.0.1 <- run_or_readRDS(
  file.path(file_cache_dir, "dge_one.v.all_sct.res.0.1.rds"), 
  function() {
    so %>%
      set_idents("SCT_snn_res.0.1") %>%
      set_assay("SCT") %>%
      FindAllMarkers()
  }
)
dge_one.v.all_sct.res.0.1_df <- dge_one.v.all_sct.res.0.1 %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::relocate(gene, .before = p_val)
```

```{r}
dge_one.v.all_sct.res.0.1_wide <- dge_one.v.all_sct.res.0.1_df %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = rank, 
              names_from = cluster, 
              values_from = gene) %>% 
  select(rank, as.character(sort(as.integer(colnames(.)[2:ncol(.)]))))
dge_one.v.all_sct.res.0.1_wide %>%
  head(100) %>% 
  DT::datatable()
```


### Assign res 0.1 clusters

```{r}
metadata_to_add <- 
  get_metadata_from_so(so, metadata = "SCT_snn_res.0.1", reduction = NULL) %>% 
  mutate(cluster_stromal = case_when(
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "0" ~ "0: Basal cells", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "1" ~ "1: Fibroblasts", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "2" ~ "2: Endothelial cells", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "3" ~ "3: Fibroblasts", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "4" ~ "4: Endothelial cells", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "5" ~ "5: Fibroblasts", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "6" ~ "6: Keratinocytes", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "7" ~ "7: Endothelial cells", 
    as.character(SCT_snn_res.0.1) == "8" ~ "8: Fibroblasts"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(cluster_stromal = fct_reorder(cluster_stromal, as.numeric(SCT_snn_res.0.1))) %>% 
  mutate(general_cluster_stromal = case_when(
    str_detect(cluster_stromal, "Fibroblasts") ~ "Fibroblasts", 
    str_detect(cluster_stromal, "Endothelial") ~ "Endothelial cells", 
    str_detect(cluster_stromal, "Keratinocytes|Basal") ~ "Keratinocytes", 
    TRUE ~ "other"  
  )) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("cell")
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = metadata_to_add)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "cluster_stromal", label = TRUE, 
            pixels = c(1024, 1024), 
            pointsize = 2.1)
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
  plot_umap(color_str = "general_cluster_stromal", label = TRUE, 
            pixels = c(1024, 1024), 
            pointsize = 2.1)
```

# Save

```{r}
saveRDS(so, file.path(file_cache_dir, "so_stromal.rds"))
```
